body_lead: Telangana Govt To Set Up AI Innovation Hub; 50000 To Get Skill Training, 10000 Jobs In Three Years The initiative, named the Telangana AI Innovation Hub (TAIH), will bring all existing AI initiatives, startups, and Centres of Excellence under one umbrella. Hyderabad: The Telangana government has decided to set up an Artificial Intelligence (AI) innovation hub in the capital city in a major push towards making the state the global AI capital.
